shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat AGENTS.md package.json 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f | head -100

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ------; rg -n -i -C3 "navigation|@gravity-ui/table|icons" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150; ls src __agent_eval__; cat src/* index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore 2>/dev/null | head -80

sed -n 452,480p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "tanstack|dnd"

npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20; npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; ls node_modules/@tanstack

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/i18n @bem-react/classname lodash @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable 2>&1 | tail -15; npm ls @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @dnd-kit/sortable @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && for p in navigation table; do echo "=== $p"; ls $p; ls $p/dist/docs $p/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; done; cat table/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|exports)"'
cat table/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; find table/build/docs -type f | head -40; echo; cat navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; find navigation/build/docs -type f | head -40
sed -n 80,400p table/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo =====NAV; sed -n 60,200p navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md
sed -n 400,700p table/build/docs/INDEX.md | rg -n -i -C2 "column|useRowSelectionFixedHandler|^####" | head -150

rg -n -i "columnOrder|ColumnReordering|enableColumn|getGroupTitle|useRowSelectionFixedHandler|dragHandleColumn" table/build/esm/index.d.ts table/build/esm/**/*.d.ts | head -40; sed -n 1,80p navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build && cat esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/*.d.ts | head -120; rg -n -i "group" esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts ../build/docs/components/BaseTable.md | head -30; ls esm/*.css esm/**/*.css 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "css" esm/index.js | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build && rg -n "logo|menuItems|renderContent|compact|onChangeCompact|headerDecoration|hideCollapseButton" esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -30; rg -n -A14 "interface AsideHeaderItem|interface MenuItem " esm/components/types.d.ts | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && rg -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow|getGroupTitle|renderGroupHeader" table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head; rg -n "logo" -A12 navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts | head -30; cd icons && ls | head -5; for n in House Persons ShoppingCart Gear; do ls | grep -E "^$n\.(js|d.ts)$|^$n$" ; done; ls | grep -c .; ls | grep -E "^(House|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|Receipt)"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n 25,60p table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js; sed -n 1,30p navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts; grep -n "ThemeProvider\|rootClassName" -r uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head -5
rg -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow" table/build/esm/hooks/useRowContent.js table/build/esm -g '*.js' | head -5; rg -n -B2 -A12 "interface LogoProps" navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts
sed -n 18,70p table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && rg -n -i "sticky" components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts; cat types/base.d.ts | head -30; cat components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls components

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/OrdersTable.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""  {...(selectionColumn as ColumnDef<OrderRow>), enableColumnReordering: false},""","""  {...selectionColumn, enableColumnReordering: false} as ColumnDef<OrderRow>,""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15

sed -i 's|{...(selectionColumn as ColumnDef<OrderRow>), enableColumnReordering: false},|{...selectionColumn, enableColumnReordering: false} as ColumnDef<OrderRow>,|' src/OrdersTable.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15

sed -i 's|{...selectionColumn, enableColumnReordering: false} as ColumnDef<OrderRow>,|Object.assign({}, selectionColumn, {enableColumnReordering: false}) as ColumnDef<OrderRow>,|' src/OrdersTable.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; echo tsc=$?; rm -rf dist; git status --short
